tolerance_freeze_rationale.public_table_precision: Published mtt6_data_mg_1_2.csv stores mg_1_2, n, a_0 and their errs at full float64 precision (15-17 significant digits); rna_map_dg stored with 12+ decimals in Zenodo rna_map_dg.csv.
tolerance_freeze_rationale.rounding: No rounding applied in published CSV artifacts; raw float64 throughout. TTRMutsDataProcessor.clean_data rounds the per-position DMS data array to 5 decimal places before gaaa_avg aggregation (deterministic, no replay noise).
tolerance_freeze_rationale.software_version: qmap_paper pip-installed from Zenodo 2024_qmap_paper-main.zip (md5=48da131a78f5027d4b1f31a58c08007b); scipy.optimize.leastsq + numpy.random.normal bootstrap. Fixed commit, fixed conda env rna_junction_preorganization_v1_1.
tolerance_freeze_rationale.numerical_solver_error: scipy.optimize.leastsq is deterministic for identical inputs BUT bootstrap residuals are perturbed by np.random.normal. Even with seed=42, cross-numpy/scipy-version floating-point ordering differences introduce drift: ~1e-9 for stable fits (well-conditioned likelihood), up to ~6e-5 relative for borderline-stable fits (e.g. UCUAAG_AAUGG mg_1_2=440.88 has rel_err=5.7e-5). For censored/unstable fits (mg_1_2>40 or degenerate n), the likelihood surface is flat and bootstrap diverges arbitrarily (observed up to 7e15 absolute).
tolerance_freeze_rationale.resampling_randomness: np.random.seed(42) set immediately BEFORE compute_all_mg_1_2; bootstrap n_runs=100; mg_conc==5.0 dropped inside compute_all_mg_1_2. Seed makes replay reproducible WITHIN identical numpy/scipy versions; cross-version drift bounded by numerical_solver_error analysis above. Censored variants are by definition the set where mg_1_2 is unreliable — their numerical value is NOT a valid replay endpoint; the censoring reason (E7) is the authoritative endpoint.

mg_1_2.justification: bootstrap seed=42 reproducible to ~1e-9 stable; ~6e-5 borderline; rel=1e-4 captures borderline while <<trend-only

mg_1_2_err.justification: same bootstrap; err is std of bootstrap distribution, slightly noisier than mean

n.justification: same bootstrap; Hill coefficient can be ill-conditioned for flat curves

gaaa_avg_per_point.justification: derived from raw counts in mttr6_data_full.json; no randomness, no bootstrap; deterministic load

rna_map_dg.justification: externally computed by RNA-MaP pipeline; published in Zenodo rna_map_dg.csv; no replay randomness

failure_reason.justification: categorical label from Q2 attrition; no numerical noise

censoring_reason.justification: categorical label from Q2 attrition; no numerical noise

structural_qc_reason.justification: categorical label from Q2 attrition; no numerical noise

censored_variants_rule.description: For the 11 right-censored variants (Q2 category=right_censored), E2_mg_1_2 and E3_uncertainty numerical comparison is NOT_APPLICABLE because the mg_1_2 value is by definition unreliable (mg_1_2>40 or unstable/unphysical fit). The authoritative endpoint for these variants is E7_censoring_reason (categorical, exact match). NOT_APPLICABLE is not a failure.

endpoints.description: Per-variant gaaa_avg at each of 15 Mg concentrations (mg_conc==5.0 excluded)
endpoints.replay_method: load mttr6_data_full.json; for each variant, extract (mg_conc, gaaa_avg) pairs excluding mg_conc==5.0; no transformation

endpoints.description: Mg2+ half-saturation concentration from Hill-equation fit
endpoints.replay_method: np.random.seed(42); qmap_paper.data_processing.compute_all_mg_1_2(df) where df=mttr6_data_full.json; NOT_APPLICABLE for right_censored variants
same as E2; errs are co-products of compute_all_mg_1_2; NOT_APPLICABLE for right_censored variants

endpoints.description: Per-variant DMS summary: baseline (gaaa_avg at mg=0), min (most-folded), saturated (gaaa_avg at mg=40)
endpoints.replay_method: deterministic aggregation of E1 curve points

endpoints.description: RNA-MaP reference free-energy mapping (rna_map_dg, rna_map_dg_err) per variant
endpoints.replay_method: load Q1 registry; no recomputation (external pipeline artifact)

endpoints.description: Q2 attrition category: fitted / right_censored / closing_pair_abnormal / alternate_structure
endpoints.replay_method: re-derive from Q2 spec rules; compare categorical label

endpoints.description: Q2 censoring sub_reason (e.g. fitted__complete_case, right_censored__mg_1_2_gt_40, right_censored__unstable_fit)
endpoints.replay_method: re-derive from Q2 spec rules; compare categorical label

endpoints.description: Q2 structural QC reason: closing-pair mutation, tetraloop-region mutation, structural abnormality flag
endpoints.replay_method: re-derive structural flags from Q1 registry act_seq/act_ss + characterize_mutations; compare categorical label

pass_criteria.numerical_pass_rule: abs_error <= abs_tol OR rel_error <= rel_tol (OR semantics)
pass_criteria.not_applicable_rule: right_censored variants are NOT_APPLICABLE for E2/E3 numerical endpoints; they must PASS E7 (censoring reason) instead
pass_criteria.no_trend_only_pass: Reproducing only correlation/scatter/trend is NOT Q3 PASS; per-variant per-endpoint comparison required
